description: A document whose own top-level `adapter: litellm` fails `cof run`'s preflight check before any effect dispatches (`cli/runtime_shim.py::preflight`, `cli/allowlist.py::walk_orchestration_refs`'s own top-level-adapter inclusion): the `litellm` library isn't installed. electricity ports preflight (issue #495), but `litellm` is a Circuitry-known adapter with no Rust builder (lane F2 left it, along with `claude_code`, `cyberdiner` and `pi`, refused up front with the preview marker instead of running preflight at all — settled ruling 3, electricity/DESIGN.md §13), so this case's intent (an unbuildable top-level adapter's preflight failure) survives F2 unchanged; it was `openai` before F2 built that adapter.
